rows.conditionalRelationship: only honoured when provisioningNetwork is Managed; ignored for Unmanaged and Disabled
rows.ownershipRecommendation: frontend UI field in the bare-metal provisioning section, data/params/4.22 catalog row, backend generation
testsRequired: generation emits only when provisioningNetwork is Managed

rows.mechanicalEvidence: pkg/types/machinepools.go MachinePool.Management; enum ClusterAPI|MachineAPI; +kubebuilder:default=ClusterAPI; gated by FeatureGateClusterAPIControlPlaneInstall / FeatureGateClusterAPIComputeInstall, enabled inDevPreviewNoUpgrade() ONLY

rows.mechanicalEvidence: pkg/types/azure/platform.go Platform.IPFamily; enum IPv4|DualStackIPv4Primary|DualStackIPv6Primary; gated by FeatureGateAzureDualStackInstall (TechPreview, DevPreview)
rows.documentationEvidence: The OCP 4.22 release notes Installation Technology Preview table 1.9.5 lists 'Installing a cluster on Amazon Web Services (AWS) with dual-stack networking' as Technology Preview in 4.22 and Not Available in 4.20/4.21. No Azure dual-stack entry was found.
rows.smallestDecisionRequired: Does an undocumented but feature-gated capability get docs-only-not-supported (parity with AWS, both unreachable without TechPreviewNoUpgrade) or hidden-not-applicable (nothing documents it)?
rows.blocksTranche2Rationale: Not exposed in v2.1 under either status; only the recorded catalog status differs.
rows.openSubQuestion: Architect models Azure Government. Commercial-cloud TP status is not automatically government-cloud TP status.

rows.reason: AWS dual-stack is documented Technology Preview for AWS; Architect's scenarios are aws-govcloud-ipi and aws-govcloud-upi. No 4.22 evidence found either way for GovCloud regions.
rows.proposedDisposition: DOCS-ONLY-NOT-SUPPORTED on Technology Preview grounds regardless of the GovCloud question
rows.recordedSo: the catalog note does not overclaim GovCloud applicability

rows.reason: Documented default changed from unconditional Classic to conditional on ipFamily. The catalog schema has no representation for a conditional default.
rows.behaviourImpact: None. ipFamily will not be exposed, so Architect always lands in the Classic branch.
rows.smallestDecisionRequired: Keep the flat Classic default with an explanatory note, or extend the catalog schema for conditional defaults?
rows.recommendation: Keep the note. A schema change for one row is not proportionate.
rows.additionalFinding: The new +kubebuilder:validation:Enum on lbType is NOT enforced by openshift-install (binary accepted lbType: Bogus). Do not add UI validation citing it as installer-enforced.
